name: Rangers of the North
description: Descendants of the Dúnedain of Arnor who protect the northern lands, especially the Shire.

name: Fellowship of the Ring
description: Nine companions who set out to destroy the One Ring.

name: Rivendell
description: The Last Homely House, an elven refuge in the valley of Imladris.
notes: Founded by Elrond in the Second Age

name: Minas Tirith
description: The great city of Gondor, built on seven levels into the side of Mount Mindolluin.
notes: Capital of Gondor, the White City

name: Mordor
description: The dark realm of Sauron, where the One Ring was forged.

name: The Shire
description: Peaceful homeland of the Hobbits in the northwest of Middle-earth.

name: Men (Humans)
description: Mortal race of Middle-earth, diverse and adaptable.

name: Elves
description: Immortal and wise firstborn children of Ilúvatar.

name: Maiar
description: Angelic spirits who serve the Valar. Gandalf and Sauron are Maiar.

name: The One Ring
description: The master ring forged by Sauron to control all other Rings of Power.
notes: Inscribed with the Black Speech: 'One Ring to rule them all'

name: White Council
description: Council of the Wise formed to oppose Sauron, led by Saruman and including Gandalf, Elrond, and Galadriel.
